name: Ibuki Akane
source:
The head of the “Red Lily Dormitory,” a dormitory that is thoroughly dedicated to sports perfomance. She is an all-around athlete who achieves top-level results in a wide variety of sports. She is a victory supremacist who believes that if she does not win, it is meaningless. She hates people who are unwilling to put in the effort to achieve this (i.e., those who do not like to practice), and she imposes hard training on the dorm residents as well. She sometimes uses violence as a form of coaching, and some of the dorm residents complain about it.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq42/]official site[/url]]
